t-money.desc: The hidden role of monetary velocity in inflation. Why the trillions printed by central banks since 2008 hadn't yet ignited consumer prices — until they did.

t-money.title: Hidden Secrets of Money — Episode 8: Fall of Empire
t-money.desc: The endgame of the seven stages introduced in Episode 2. How dollar reserves are exiting the system and what replaces them.

t-money.desc: Updated 2022 view: where Maloney landed on Bitcoin, the precious metals overlap, and the role both play in a portfolio that survives a monetary reset.

t-money.desc: The cultural and political dynamics of late-stage empire — how the focus shifts from production to entertainment as the monetary base hollows out.
